patch_list: Reward buttons (free revive, double coins) pay out instantly without playing any ad video (native libil2cpp.so patch for both arm64-v8a and armeabi-v7a).
Stops all interstitial/commercial-break ads between games (native libil2cpp.so patch for both arm64-v8a and armeabi-v7a; rewarded videos are handled by the instant-rewards patch).
Coin save reads always return ~1.34 billion coins (native libil2cpp.so patch on Org.TotalCoins for both arm64-v8a and armeabi-v7a).
